paragraphs.text:
If a creature is said to be
susceptible to exorcism,
you may use the
Exorcism Arcane Skill
against it. If you
successfully use the
Exorcism Arcane Skill
against the creature’s L,
the creature is forced to
leave the box
immediately. If the
creature is guarding
some item, you will gain
access to that item as the
creature runs away.
